title: Mononuclear Co(II) polypyridyl complexes: synthesis, molecular structure, DNA binding/cleavage, radical scavenging, docking studies and anticancer activities.
authors: Karumban, Kalai Selvan; Muley, Arabinda; Raut, Rajnikant; Gupta, Parth; Giri, Bishnubasu; Kumbhakar, Sadananda; Misra, Ashish; Maji, Somnath
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Co(II)多吡啶配合物与DNA的结合/切割及抗癌活性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系中的DNA结合，但对象为小分子配合物而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法以实验为主，仅含简单对接，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Mononuclear Co(II) complexes [Co(II)(L)Cl(2)]; 1, [Co(II)(L)(bpy)Cl]PF(6); 2, [Co(II)(L)(phen)Cl]PF(6); 3 and [Co(II)(L)(pic)Cl]; 4, (where L = N,N-bis(pyridin-2-ylmethyl)aniline, bpy = 2,2'-bipyridine, phen = 1,10-phenanthroline, pic = picolinic acid) were systematically synthesized and characterized by different analytical and spectroscopic methods. All the complexes were structurally identified by single-crystal X-ray diffraction analysis. Penta-coordinated complex 1 adopted a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry, whereas hexacoordinated complexes 2-4 have distorted octahedral geometry. The interactions of salmon sperm DNA (ss-DNA) with our synthesized complexes 1-4 were investigated by absorbance and fluorescence spectroscopy. All the complexes are very susceptible to DNA binding and exhibited binding affinities (K(b)) in the order of  approximately 10(4) M(-1), indicating their strong interaction with ss-DNA. The Stern-Volmer constant (K(sv)) ranged from 0.46 +/- 0.01 x 10(4) to 1.08 +/- 0.04 x 10(4) M(-1), suggesting weak or moderate binding with DNA. Agarose gel electrophoresis revealed the DNA cleavage activity in vitro for 2-4, which could efficiently cleave the supercoiled plasmid DNA without any external agents; however, with the addition of H(2)O(2), the cleavage property was enhanced. Live-cell imaging and other biochemical assays demonstrated the ability of Co(II) complexes 1-4 to induce significant cytotoxicity in A549 lung cancer cells with IC(50) values of 32.14 +/- 1.3 muM, 3.14 +/- 0.16 muM, 15.78 +/- 0.72 muM and 18.45 +/- 0.92 muM, and in MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells with IC(50) values of 20.42 +/- 0.92 muM, 0.41 +/- 0.02 muM, 2.31 +/- 0.12 muM and 9.67 +/- 0.35 muM, respectively.
abstract_zh: 单核Co(II)配合物[Co(II)(L)Cl(2)]；1，[Co(II)(L)(bpy)Cl]PF(6)；2，[Co(II)(L)(phen)Cl]PF(6)；3和[Co(II)(L)(pic)Cl]；4（其中L = N,N-双(吡啶-2-基甲基)苯胺，bpy = 2,2'-联吡啶，phen = 1,10-菲咯啉，pic = 吡啶甲酸）被系统合成，并通过不同的分析和光谱方法进行表征。所有配合物均通过单晶X射线衍射分析进行结构鉴定。五配位配合物1采用畸变三角双锥几何构型，而六配位配合物2-4具有畸变八面体几何构型。通过吸收光谱和荧光光谱研究了鲑鱼精子DNA（ss-DNA）与合成的配合物1-4之间的相互作用。所有配合物对DNA结合非常敏感，其结合亲和力（K(b)）约为10(4) M(-1)数量级，表明它们与ss-DNA有强相互作用。Stern-Volmer常数（K(sv)）范围为0.46 +/- 0.01 x 10(4)至1.08 +/- 0.04 x 10(4) M(-1)，表明与DNA的结合较弱或中等。琼脂糖凝胶电泳显示2-4在体外具有DNA切割活性，无需任何外部试剂即可有效切割超螺旋质粒DNA；然而，加入H(2)O(2)后，切割性能增强。活细胞成像和其他生化分析表明，Co(II)配合物1-4能够诱导A549肺癌细胞显著细胞毒性，IC(50)值分别为32.14 +/- 1.3 muM、3.14 +/- 0.16 muM、15.78 +/- 0.72 muM和18.45 +/- 0.92 muM，在MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞中IC(50)值分别为20.42 +/- 0.92 muM、0.41 +/- 0.02 muM、2.31 +/- 0.12 muM和9.67 +/- 0.35 muM。
